WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_all_orders
  FROM per_order
), first_winners AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark,
         p.avg_fill_size,
         p.avg_fill_size - b.avg_all_orders AS margin_over_first
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_fill_size > b.avg_all_orders
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_first_winners
  FROM first_winners
), final_orders AS (
  SELECT w.avg_fill_size,
         w.margin_over_first,
         w.avg_fill_size - b.avg_first_winners AS margin_over_second
  FROM first_winners w
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b
  WHERE w.avg_fill_size > b.avg_first_winners
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size,
       AVG(margin_over_first) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(margin_over_second) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark
FROM final_orders
